content: Letter 27 continued: Ibn Turka says that to his shame he still depends on his friends' protection for survival, that his family suffers mightily, and petitions (ʿarż-dāsht) the amir to pursue his case and restore his stipend (dāranda). He closes with a hadith on every man setting out and selling himself, and Q 32:21, in a pious meditation on the purpose of suffering. A note about one Rukn al-Dīn/ʿAżud al-Dīn appended in TMN/M appears as a freestanding ḥāshiya before letter 2 in TMN/MS.
